ITEM 1 | Pale yellow-cream florets, battered or coated with a light golden fried crust, clustered in an irregular heap covering roughly 45% of the square white plate; individual florets about 2-4 cm across with bumpy, slightly crisp surface and some browned edges; sits on the plate with a few loose pieces scattered | 150
ITEM 2 | Single small pale yellow-golden fried floret piece, about 2 cm across, slightly crisp with a rounded lumpy surface, separate from the main heap on the left side of the plate | 12
ITEM 3 | Few small fresh dark green leaves, flat and slightly glossy, about 3-5 cm long, tucked among the florets at the lower right and center of the plate, with no visible sauce | 5
